title: 558 comment units in the s4 cells carry a sentence over 40 words (C5)
claim: Of the 3367 D5 comment units in custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/{j..z}*.py and www/*.js, 558 (16.6 %, in 45 of 51 files) hold at least one sentence over 40 words, 716 such sentences in all, the longest 156 words.
mechanism: Comments and docstrings grow by appended clauses (dashes, semicolons, parentheticals) rather than new sentences; nothing in the gate measures sentence length, so criterion C5 has no detector.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:units_of over the production comment text of custom_components/heatpump_optimizer (e.g. pump_mode.py module docstring)

perturbation.change: one-line production edit: pump_mode.py line 6 'the mode — reads its answer from here, so there is' -> 'the mode. All read their answer from here, so there is' (comments.py --file custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_mode.py --edit 'custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_mode.py|the mode — reads its answer from here, so there is|the mode. All read their answer from here, so there is')

metric_definition: Count of D5 units (text_ledger units --dim D5, seat D5-s4) with a text_ledger.sentences() sentence of more than 40 whitespace words, comment markers stripped.
phenomenon_property: Every comment and docstring sentence in the seat's cells is at most 40 words (D5-criteria C5).
proposed_fix_scope: Split the 716 sentences (253 docstring units, 305 comment units; the card holds 155 units); optionally add the 40-word check to a lint lane so C5 stays measured.
